podcast.title: Origin of Biff Naked's Stage Name
podcast.body: Biff Naked was a member of the punk band Gorilla Gorilla while studying drama at the University of Winnipeg. It was within this band that a fellow member suggested adding "Naked" to her stage name, which then stuck. "The naked part came when she was in a punk band called Gorilla Gorilla."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Lost CanRock Bands of the '90s: Part 1

xref.title: Origin of Stage Name
xref.body: The name "Biff Naked" originated from two separate events: she was called "Biff" since grade eight, and the "Naked" part was added by a bandmate in her punk band Gorilla Gorilla while she was studying drama at the University of Winnipeg, inspired by a friend who was a stripper. "She's been called Biff since she was in grade eight. The naked part came when she was in a punk band called Gorilla Gorilla."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
